title: M5Cardputer-UserDemo #48 round 3: repo pins rather than mutates the toolchain; ESP-IDF 6.1 build needs upstream component port

execution.environment: macOS arm64; ESP-IDF v6.1 checkout with idf6.1_py3.13_env; Python 3.13.15; temp clone /tmp/cpadv48
execution.command: git clone -b CardputerADV; python3 ./fetch_repos.py; idf.py build; idf.py add-dependency espressif/usb; idf.py build

evidence_class: code-level verification, build-executed (real ESP-IDF v6.1 configure and compile); no hardware or virtual-device runtime

checks.name: issue_open_latest_comment_unanswered
checks.evidence: state=OPEN, 4 comments; latest 2026-11-23T18:21:33Z by nuncio-bitis; no m5agent comment after it; evidence/issue-48.json

checks.name: repo_does_not_mutate_toolchain
checks.evidence: root tree has no install.sh/requirements; fetch_repos.py only clones git components into gitignored components/; 0 patch entries in repos.json; evidence/repo-toolchain-declaration.txt

checks.name: toolchain_declared_not_vendored
checks.evidence: README.md:15 ESP-IDF v5.4.2; dependencies.lock:54-57 idf 5.4.2; main/idf_component.yml idf '>=4.1.0'; evidence/repo-toolchain-declaration.txt

checks.name: fetched_component_tags_match_repos_json
checks.evidence: M5GFX 0.2.15, M5Unified 0.2.10, mooncake v2.2.0, mooncake_log v1.3.0, smooth_ui_toolkit v2.4.0; evidence/component-refs.txt

checks.evidence: Failed to resolve component 'usb' required by component 'espressif__esp_tinyusb'; IDF HINT: usb removed, use espressif/usb; evidence/idf61-configure-fail.txt

checks.name: idf_6_1_build_fails_in_pinned_m5gfx_under_c23
checks.evidence: after adding only espressif/usb, build reaches 1164/1515 then lgfx_qrcode.h:42 'bool' cannot be defined via 'typedef' with -std=gnu23; BUILD_RC=2; evidence/idf61-compile-fail.txt

checks.name: build_idf_5_4_2
checks.evidence: no ESP-IDF 5.4.2 toolchain installed locally; declared-toolchain buildability not re-proven by this round

checks.name: build_idf_6_1_full
checks.evidence: stopped at first component compile error; later 6.x incompatibilities remain unknown

checks.name: hardware_validation
checks.evidence: failures occur before a firmware image exists

checks.name: virtual_device_validation
checks.evidence: no image/port/framebuffer exists at configure or component compile stage; Device Service and esp-emulator cannot exercise it

limitations: ESP-IDF v5.4.2 build was not executed, so 'builds on the declared toolchain' rests on documentation and prior layout analysis, not a fresh build.
The v6.1 attempt was stopped at the first failing component, so additional 6.x incompatibilities may exist.
The component manager upgraded dependencies.lock from format 2.0.0 to 3.0.0 in the temp clone; this is tool behaviour and not used as evidence.
